speaker.name: Data Dave
speaker.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

output.objection: You framed my request as a technical preference, but it is actually a trade off where I am asking you to accept a delay in feature rollout to keep the pipeline stable during the heatwave. I need that trade off acknowledged explicitly so we do not blame the data team later when the forecast misses.
output.correction: I did not say the weather feed is broken or that we should drop it, I said the pipeline needs to be stable before we add another external dependency. If you file this as a data quality issue, you are missing the point that I am prioritizing operational resilience over feature velocity right now.
